types.name: triggers.v1.CancelTriggerRequest
types.doc: CancelTriggerRequest cancels an active trigger by ID.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID to cancel.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Optional sub-account for authorization.

types.name: triggers.v1.CancelTriggerResponse
types.doc: CancelTriggerResponse returns the final status after cancellation.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID that was canceled.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Final status (should be CANCELLED).

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: triggers.v1.CreateTriggerRequest
types.doc:
CreateTriggerRequest creates a standalone trigger (stop order, TWAP, ladder,
 etc.). Standalone triggers have independent lifecycle and arm immediately
 after creation.

cel.message: trigger_price_ticks must be > 0 for STOP_LOSS and TAKE_PROFIT
limit_price_ticks required for LIMIT child orders

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account. When empty or omitted, uses the caller's root account.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Symbol, for example "BTC-USDT"; resolved to a numeric symbol ID.

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.doc: Type of trigger. Required.

fields.name: trigger_price_ticks
fields.doc: Trigger price in ticks. Required for STOP_LOSS/TAKE_PROFIT.

fields.name: trigger_price_source
fields.doc: Price source for trigger evaluation. Defaults to LAST_PRICE.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side for the child order. Required.

fields.name: order_type
fields.doc: Order type for the child order (LIMIT or MARKET). Defaults to MARKET.

fields.name: tif
fields.doc:
Time-in-force for the child order. Defaults to GTC for LIMIT, IOC for
 MARKET.

fields.name: qty_scaled
fields.doc: Quantity in base asset scale units. Required.

fields.name: limit_price_ticks
fields.doc: Limit price in ticks for LIMIT child orders.

fields.name: fee_source
fields.doc:
Fee source selection for BUY child orders. SELL child orders always pay in
 QUOTE.

 When omitted (UNSPECIFIED), defaults to QUOTE.

fields.name: stp_mode
fields.doc:
Self-trade prevention mode for child orders.

 When omitted (UNSPECIFIED), defaults to EXPIRE_MAKER.

fields.name: post_only
fields.doc: If true, child LIMIT orders are post-only (rejected if they would cross).

fields.name: trailing_distance_ticks
fields.doc: Trailing distance in absolute ticks.

fields.name: trailing_distance_bps
fields.doc: Trailing distance in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

fields.name: activation_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Optional activation price: trailing only starts after this price is
 reached.

fields.name: max_slippage_ticks
fields.doc: Maximum allowed slippage in absolute ticks.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc: Maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

fields.name: twap_duration_ms
fields.doc: Total duration of TWAP execution in milliseconds. Required for TWAP.

fields.name: twap_slice_interval_ms
fields.doc: Interval between TWAP slices in milliseconds. Required for TWAP.

fields.name: ladder_price_min_ticks
fields.doc: Minimum price in ticks for the ladder range.

fields.name: ladder_price_max_ticks
fields.doc: Maximum price in ticks for the ladder range.

fields.name: ladder_levels
fields.doc:
Number of price levels in the ladder.
 Required for LADDER; valid range is 2..100.

fields.name: ladder_distribution
fields.doc: Distribution of quantity across levels.

fields.name: client_trigger_id
fields.doc: Client-provided trigger ID for idempotency. Required.

types.name: triggers.v1.CreateTriggerResponse
types.doc: CreateTriggerResponse returns the accepted trigger identifier and status.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Unique trigger ID assigned by the system.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status of the trigger.

fields.name: client_trigger_id
fields.doc: Echoed back if provided in request.

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: triggers.v1.GetTriggerRequest
types.doc: GetTriggerRequest retrieves one trigger by ID.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID to retrieve.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Optional sub-account for authorization.

types.name: triggers.v1.GetTriggerResponse
types.doc: GetTriggerResponse returns the requested trigger.

fields.name: trigger
fields.doc: Trigger state and configuration.

types.name: triggers.v1.LadderDetails
types.doc: LadderDetails contains configuration for LADDER triggers.

fields.name: ladder_price_min_ticks
fields.doc: Minimum price in ticks for the ladder range (6 decimals).

fields.name: ladder_price_max_ticks
fields.doc: Maximum price in ticks for the ladder range (6 decimals).

fields.name: ladder_levels
fields.doc: Number of price levels in the ladder.

fields.name: ladder_distribution
fields.doc: Quantity distribution across ladder levels.

types.name: triggers.v1.LadderDistribution
types.doc: LadderDistribution defines how quantity is distributed across ladder levels.

types.name: triggers.v1.ListTriggerEventsRequest
types.doc: ListTriggerEventsRequest lists historical events for one trigger.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID to list events for.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account (authorization). When empty or omitted, uses the
 caller's root account.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted; maximum
 is 1000.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated account, trigger, sub-account scope, and newest
 first sort order.

types.name: triggers.v1.ListTriggerEventsResponse
types.doc: ListTriggerEventsResponse returns historical events ordered newest-first.

fields.name: events
fields.doc:
Events ordered by event time descending, child sequence descending, and
 stable event tie-breakers descending.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: triggers.v1.ListTriggersRequest
types.doc: ListTriggersRequest lists triggers for an account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional sub-account to list triggers for. When empty or omitted, uses the
 caller's root account.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Optional filter by symbol.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Optional filter by status (can specify multiple).

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.doc: Optional filter by type.

fields.name: parent_order_id
fields.doc: Optional filter by attached parent order ID.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of triggers to return. Defaults to 100 when omitted;
 maximum is 1000.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated account, sub-account scope, filters, and newest
 first sort order.

types.name: triggers.v1.ListTriggersResponse
types.doc: ListTriggersResponse returns triggers ordered newest-first.

fields.name: triggers
fields.doc: Triggers ordered by creation time descending, then trigger ID descending.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

Patch fields for safe price, trailing-distance, and slippage edits.
 For stop/take-profit:
 Updated trigger price in ticks.

fields.name: limit_price_ticks

fields.name: trailing_distance_ticks
fields.doc: Updated trailing distance in absolute ticks.

fields.name: trailing_distance_bps

fields.name: activation_price_ticks
fields.doc: Updated activation price in ticks.

fields.name: max_slippage_ticks
fields.doc: Updated maximum allowed slippage in absolute ticks.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc: Updated maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

fields.name: status

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: triggers.v1.StopDetails
types.doc: StopDetails contains configuration for STOP_LOSS and TAKE_PROFIT triggers.

fields.name: trigger_price_ticks
fields.doc: Trigger threshold price in ticks (6 decimals).

fields.name: trigger_price_source
fields.doc: Price source used for trigger evaluation.

fields.name: trigger_direction
fields.doc: Direction the price must cross to fire the trigger.

types.name: triggers.v1.TrailingDetails
types.doc:
TrailingDetails contains configuration and runtime state for TRAILING_STOP
 triggers.

fields.name: trailing_distance_ticks
fields.doc: Trailing distance in absolute ticks (6 decimals).

fields.name: activation_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Optional activation price: trailing only starts after this price is
 reached.

fields.name: peak_price_ticks
fields.doc: Current peak price in ticks for sell trailing stops.

fields.name: trough_price_ticks
fields.doc: Current trough price in ticks for buy trailing stops.

fields.name: trailing_distance_bps
fields.doc: Trailing distance in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

fields.name: max_slippage_ticks
fields.doc: Optional maximum allowed slippage in absolute ticks.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc: Optional maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

fields.name: trigger_price_source
fields.doc: Direction/source are fixed per trigger; exposed for completeness.

types.name: triggers.v1.Trigger
types.doc: Trigger represents a trigger with its full state.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Public account or sub-account ID associated with the trigger.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Trading symbol numeric identifier.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Trading symbol, for example "BTC-USDT".

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.doc: Trigger category.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current trigger lifecycle status.

fields.name: parent_order_id
fields.doc: Parent order ID for attached-risk triggers; empty for standalone triggers.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Child order side.

fields.name: order_type
fields.doc: Child order type.

fields.name: tif
fields.doc: Child order time-in-force policy.

fields.name: qty_scaled
fields.doc: Child order quantity in scaled base units.

fields.name: limit_price_ticks
fields.doc: Child LIMIT order price in ticks. Zero for MARKET child orders.

fields.name: fee_source
fields.doc: Fee source for BUY child orders.

fields.name: stp_mode
fields.doc: Self-trade prevention mode for child orders.

fields.name: post_only
fields.doc: True if child LIMIT orders are post-only.

fields.name: stop
fields.doc: Stop-loss or take-profit trigger details.

fields.name: trailing
fields.doc: Trailing-stop trigger details.

fields.name: twap
fields.doc: TWAP trigger details.

fields.name: ladder
fields.doc: Ladder trigger details.

fields.name: client_trigger_id
fields.doc: Client-provided trigger ID for idempotency and correlation.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Creation timestamp.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Last update timestamp.

fields.name: armed_at
fields.doc: Timestamp when the trigger became armed.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.doc: Timestamp when the trigger reached a terminal successful state.

fields.name: child_order_ids
fields.doc: Child orders spawned by this trigger.

types.name: triggers.v1.TriggerEvent
types.doc: TriggerEvent describes one historical trigger lifecycle event.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID associated with the event.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Public account or sub-account ID associated with the trigger.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Trading symbol numeric identifier.

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.doc: Trigger type at the time of the event.

fields.name: event_type
fields.doc: Event category.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Event timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: child_seq
fields.doc: Child sequence number for multi-child trigger strategies.

fields.name: child_order_id
fields.doc: Child order ID created by this event, if any.

fields.name: fire_px_ticks
fields.doc: Price that caused the trigger to fire, in ticks. Zero when not applicable.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Optional cancel reason.

types.name: triggers.v1.TriggerEventType
types.doc: TriggerEventType defines append-only trigger lifecycle events for history.

values.name: FIRED
values.doc: Trigger fired and may have created a child order.

values.name: UPDATED
values.doc: Trigger configuration or lifecycle state was updated.

types.name: triggers.v1.TriggerStatus
types.doc: TriggerStatus represents the lifecycle state of a trigger.

values.name: CREATED
values.doc: Trigger was created and is pending activation.

values.name: ARMED
values.doc: Trigger admitted and actively evaluating conditions.

values.name: RUNNING
values.doc: Trigger is actively executing (for example, TWAP slices in progress).

values.name: COMPLETED
values.doc: Trigger completed successfully (all child orders placed/filled).

values.name: FAILED
values.doc: Trigger failed (for example, reservation failure, child order rejection).

values.name: PAUSED
values.doc: Trigger is paused (user-initiated, can be resumed).

types.name: triggers.v1.TriggerType
types.doc: TriggerType defines the category of standalone trigger.

values.name: STOP_LOSS
values.doc: Stop-loss: fires when the price crosses a threshold.

values.name: TAKE_PROFIT
values.doc: Take-profit: fires when the price crosses a threshold.

values.name: TRAILING_STOP
values.doc: Trailing stop: dynamic stop that trails price by a distance.

values.name: TWAP
values.doc: TWAP: Time-Weighted Average Price execution over a duration.

values.name: LADDER
values.doc: Ladder/Scaled: Multiple orders placed across a price range.

types.name: triggers.v1.TwapDetails
types.doc: TwapDetails contains configuration and runtime state for TWAP triggers.

fields.name: twap_duration_ms
fields.doc: Total duration of TWAP execution in milliseconds.

fields.name: twap_slice_interval_ms
fields.doc: Interval between TWAP slices in milliseconds.

fields.name: slice_idx
fields.doc: Current slice index, zero-based.

fields.name: slice_count
fields.doc: Total number of planned slices.

fields.name: executed_qty_scaled
fields.doc: Cumulative executed quantity in scaled base units.
